title: WIPRO earnings-call transcript

title: WIPRO earnings-call transcript
text: Operating cash flow was 166% of net income in Q2 FY27. Interpretation: cash conversion is strong, while the revenue outlook permits contraction; monitor seasonal furloughs and deal conversion. Cash conversion and growth measure different things.

title: WIPRO annual report
text: Wipro describes a dedicated AI-native business and platforms unit launched in April 2026. It aims to build and scale platforms, develop enterprise agentic AI, and incubate new businesses. Capco focuses on management and technology consulting for financial services and energy. Interpretation: execution, monetization and client adoption matter more than the existence of the new unit.

title: TCS annual report
text: TCS describes a full-stack AI strategy across compute, cloud, data, platforms, models and applications. Its transformation plan includes internal AI adoption, redesigning services with human and AI delivery, developing talent and participating in the AI ecosystem. Interpretation: this is a strategic aspiration, not financial guidance or a demonstrated return on investment.
